Overview.Name: Anusha Daripelli
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small) & boiled egg (1)
Option 3: Paneer bhurji (70 g) & salad (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & mutton curry (moderate portion) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid cauliflower and broccoli as mentioned and focus on easy to digest vegetables.
Since thyroid and PCOS are present, keep protein steady in each meal to support hormone balance.
Sweet cravings during stress can be managed by eating eggs or paneer first before choosing sweets.
Keep meal timing consistent to improve energy and reduce overeating triggers.
Simple pan cooked or grilled meals will help maintain long term consistency.
